title: 5.3 Introduction to Websites
description: Websites concepts and details. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is a website?
options: A collection of web pages on a server
A single page printed on a paper sheet
questions.correctAnswer: A collection of web pages on a server

questions.question: Where is a website hosted?
How is a website accessed?
What is the simplest form of a website?
Which purpose includes news platforms and blogs?
Which purpose includes Amazon and eBay?
Which purpose builds brand identity?
Which purpose includes FAQs and live chat?
Which purpose includes forums and discussion boards?
Which purpose includes streaming and games?
What is a web page?
options: An HTML document with structure and layout
A printed document stored in an office folder
questions.correctAnswer: An HTML document with structure and layout

questions.question: What do HTML tags define in a web page?
options: The structure and layout of content
The speed of the network connection
questions.correctAnswer: The structure and layout of content

questions.question: Which element enables navigation between pages?
Which are multimedia elements on a web page?
Which form element allows only one choice?
Which form element collects typed text?
Which element sends a completed form?
What is a static website?
options: A site whose content stays the same until edited
A site built with server-side scripting
A site that generates pages on the fly
A site that personalizes content for each visitor
questions.correctAnswer: A site whose content stays the same until edited

questions.question: What is a dynamic website?
options: A site that builds pages on demand
A site with fixed HTML content stored
A site hosted on one computer
A site with only text documents
questions.correctAnswer: A site that builds pages on demand
